simple.summary: רַעֲלָה (raʻălâh) means a long veil (as fluttering ) First listed occurrence: Isa 3 19.

definitions.full: H7479. realah [ רְעָלָה ] noun [feminine] probably veil (compare Arabic above); — plural הָֽרְעָלוֺת Isa 3:19 , in list of finery. מַרְעֲלָה see above .
